game.loading_description: Please wait while new questions are being prepared...

quick_thinking.0: Solve as many basic arithmetic problems as possible in 60 seconds. Speed is the key!
quick_thinking.1: Questions involve quick addition, subtraction, and simple multiplications. Each correct answer earns 1 point.
quick_thinking.2: For every 4 incorrect answers, 1 point will be deducted from your score. Answer quickly but accurately!

multiply_divide.0: Master multiplication tables in 60 seconds. Focus on multiplication and division problems.
multiply_divide.1: Questions will test your knowledge of multiplication and division facts from 1×1 to 10×10. Each correct answer is worth 1 point.
multiply_divide.2: A penalty of 1 point will be applied after every 4 wrong answers. Practice daily to improve your multiplication skills!

true_or_false.0: You'll see mathematical equations and must decide if they are TRUE or FALSE within 60 seconds.
true_or_false.1: Swipe RIGHT for TRUE equations and LEFT for FALSE ones. Each correct judgment earns you 1 point.
true_or_false.2: Be careful! For every 4 incorrect judgments, 1 point will be deducted. Trust your instincts but verify the math!

expert.0: Face challenging problems involving multiple operations, powers, and complex calculations within 60 seconds.
expert.1: Questions include advanced arithmetic, algebraic expressions, and multi-step problems. Each correct solution earns 2 points.
expert.2: The penalty for mistakes is higher: 2 points deducted after every 4 wrong answers. This mode is for math enthusiasts seeking a real challenge!

training.0: In Training Mode, there's no time limit. Practice at your own pace to improve your math skills.
training.1: Problems increase in category as you progress. Your session continues until you choose to end it, with no score penalties.
training.2: This mode tracks accuracy rather than speed. Use it to build confidence and master concepts before trying timed challenges.

settings_about.expert_mode_desc: A 120-second challenge featuring advanced operators; 60+ correct answers earn "Master" status.
settings_about.training_mode_desc: Unlimited time, 50 questions per session—practice with zero pressure.
settings_about.daily_coin: Collect a free daily coin bonus.

settings_about.spend_coins: Spend coins to lift category limits, unlock higher difficulties, and chase new personal bests.

settings_privacy_policy.privacy_introduction_text: ZifroMania LLC ("Company," "we," "us") respects your privacy. This Policy explains what data we collect via the ZifroMania mobile application ("App"), how we use and protect it, and the choices you have.

settings_privacy_policy.device_data_desc: Device model, OS version, language, advertising ID, and basic log information.
settings_privacy_policy.usage_data_desc: Scores, progress, achievements, session length, and interaction events.
settings_privacy_policy.purchase_data_desc: Order ID, product, timestamp, and status received from Google Play Billing.
settings_privacy_policy.analytics_data_desc: Anonymous event metrics and ad impressions collected by Firebase Analytics and Google AdMob.
settings_privacy_policy.use_data_1: Operate and maintain the App and its core features.
settings_privacy_policy.use_data_2: Personalise game category, rewards, and advertising.
settings_privacy_policy.use_data_3: Process in-app purchases and maintain coin balances.
settings_privacy_policy.use_data_4: Detect, prevent, and address fraud or abuse.
settings_privacy_policy.use_data_5: Analyse aggregated statistics to improve performance and content.
settings_privacy_policy.google_admob_desc: delivers ads and may use the Android advertising ID for frequency capping and fraud prevention. See Google's policy:
settings_privacy_policy.firebase_analytics_desc: provides anonymous usage statistics (events are not linked to personally identifiable information).
settings_privacy_policy.google_play_billing_desc: securely processes subscriptions and one-time purchases.
settings_privacy_policy.data_security_text: We use industry-standard encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256) where applicable. Personal data is retained only as long as needed for the purposes described or as required by law, after which it is securely deleted or anonymised.
settings_privacy_policy.childrens_privacy_text: The App is suitable for users of all ages, including children under 13. We comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and applicable local regulations (e.g., GDPR-K). We collect only the minimum data necessary for gameplay and do not knowingly collect sensitive personal information from children. A parent or legal guardian may review or delete their child's data at any time by contacting us at the e-mail address below.
settings_privacy_policy.your_rights_text: Subject to local law, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete the personal data we hold about you. You can make these requests by e-mail. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe and in accordance with applicable regulations.
settings_privacy_policy.changes_to_policy_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced via an in-app notice or similar mechanism. Continued use of the App after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By installing or using the ZifroMania mobile application (the "App"), you agree to these Terms of Service ("Terms") and to our Privacy Policy. ZifroMania LLC ("Company", "we", "us") may revise the Terms at any time; the revised version becomes effective once posted on this page.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content: The App is suitable for all age groups. If you are a minor in your jurisdiction (typically under 18 years old), please obtain permission from a parent or legal guardian before making any in-app purchases.

accounts.title: Accounts and Access
accounts.content: You may access the App via Google Sign-In or by creating an e-mail-and-password account through Firebase Authentication. You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Using another person's account without authorization is prohibited.

gameplay.title: Gameplay Rules and Prohibited Conduct
gameplay.rule1: Automated scripts, bots, emulators, or hacking tools are prohibited.
gameplay.rule2: Reverse-engineering, decompiling, or modifying the App's code is not allowed.
gameplay.rule3: Accounts violating these rules may be suspended or terminated without notice.

virtual_currency.title: Virtual Currency (Coins)
virtual_currency.content: Coins are a virtual currency usable only within the App. They have no real-world monetary value and cannot be transferred to other accounts or third parties. ZifroMania LLC reserves the right to change coin balances, earning methods, and pricing at any time.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions and In-App Purchases
subscriptions.note: Payments are processed through your Google Play account. Subscriptions may be cancelled at any time via Google Play settings. Except where required by law, purchases of virtual coins or partially used subscription periods are non-refundable.

advertising.title: Advertising and Analytics
advertising.content: The free tier of the App may display advertisements. The App uses Google AdMob, Firebase Analytics, and similar services, which may collect device information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Our practices regarding the collection, storage, and processing of personal data are detailed in our Privacy Policy. By using the App, you also agree to that policy.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: All materials in the App—including software, logo, content, question database, graphics, and code—are the property of ZifroMania LLC and may not be copied, distributed, or modified without our prior written consent.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.content: The App is provided "as is". ZifroMania LLC makes no warranties that the App will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, ZifroMania LLC shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with your use of the App.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: You may terminate these Terms at any time by uninstalling the App. We may suspend or terminate your account without notice if we reasonably believe you have violated these Terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions, complaints, or feedback, please email us at rasul.ramixanov@gmail.com.

terms.final_note: By continuing to use the App, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to all of the above Terms.
